detail.longDescription: A spinner tells a screen reader user nothing unless something is announced. Loading, done and failed all need a status message, and users need to know whether they can leave. Async-heavy SaaS UIs get this wrong constantly. # accessibility # a11y # webdev https:// dev.to/urielbitton/saas-loadin g-states-tell-users-when-work-is-really-finished-2neo
